name: Shire Stroll
description: A sunny hillside with a round-door hobbit hole, a winding lane and a picket fence. Five kinds of little folk stroll past at random; chimney smoke curls, clouds drift and butterflies flutter.

steps.script: const n = project.elements.length; ['Hour','Colon','Minute'].forEach((nm,i)=>{ project.elements[n-3+i].name = nm + ' Aod'; }); return 1

project.groups = project.groups || {}; project.groups.gFolk = 'Strollers'; project.groups.gSky = 'Sky and smoke'; let n = 0; for (const e of project.elements) { if (/^(Walker|Pipe puff)/.test(e.name)) { e.group = 'gFolk'; n++ } if (/^(Clouds|Chimney smoke|Butterfly)/.test(e.name)) { e.group = 'gSky'; n++ } } return n
